clauses.text: When the user hits with a Damaging Move, they gain 1 Acuity or 1 Vigor based on the class of Move used (Vigor for Special and Acuity for Physical). For every Acuity the user possesses, they deal +5 bonus damage on the next Special Damaging Move used, after which they lose all their accrued Acuity. Similarly, for every Vigor the user possesses, they deal +5 bonus damage on the next Physical Damaging Move used, after which they lose all their accrued Vigor. At Rank 1, the user may only have up to 2 Acuity or 2 Vigor at one time. At Rank 2, these caps increase to 4. Additionally, if the user reduces their Acuity from 4 to 0, the receive +2 Vigor, similarly, if the user reduces their Vigor from 4 to 0, they receive +2 Acuity (instead of starting from 0 plus the one received from the triggering Move).
